notes.title: Patch v1.09.157
notes.content:
Leaderboard per mission.
Run against multiple ghosts at the same time. The black ghost is your best run. The red ghost is the dev ghost. The blue ghost is the another player's ghost.

notes.title: Patch v1.08.156
notes.content:
Store and retrieve camera mode when replay start.
Fix mission progress lost. Progress is now only saved on cloud. Mission mode is not anymore available in offline mode.
Fix typo Artic => Arctic.
Fix music no looping.
Fix reverb deactivation when exiting tunnel.

notes.title: Patch v1.07.154
notes.content:
QuickRestart button can now be used during the end of race sequence
The race of the day now ends at 11:55pm UTC and starts at 0:05am UTC. During the 10 minutes gap, it is not possible to start the race (button is disabled) and the restart button is hidden at the end of the race.
